[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Another Sorting Problem** [CF 1575A · Another Sorting Problem](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1575/A){rating="1100"}

All keys have the same length $m$ over a 26-letter alphabet: that is exactly the shape LSD radix sort was made for (@sec-lts-a3). Flip every even column's letter ($c \mapsto 25 - c$) so that every column sorts ascending, then run one **stable** counting sort per column, from the last column to the first. No two strings are ever compared; the work is $O(m(n + 26)) = O(nm)$, linear in the size of the input.

[Solved in full in @sec-lts-p6-a.]{.card-link}

:::
